entities.summary: Friedrich Karl Gustav Freiherr von Langenau, Imperial Field Marshal-Lieutenant, was Quartermaster-General of the Army of Bohemia, in 1814, and Austrian Army of the Upper Rhine, under Schwarzenberg in 1815.
